$schema.description: URL to the schema for this configuration file.

connectors.description: Connector rows pointing at external sources (GitHub, Notion, …). The file is synced as a canonical unit — tokens must never ride in it.

items.description: A single connector instance. Credentials are resolved at run time from the opaque "secretRef" — raw tokens and token-shaped fields are rejected by the runtime validator.

id.description: Stable id for this connector instance within the project (e.g. "github-main"). Unique across rows.

type.description: Connector type — matches a registered connector type (e.g. "github", "notion").

enabled.description: Whether the runner should include this connector. Defaults to true.

schedule.description: Optional schedule hint (cron-ish). Stored but not enforced — execution happens only while the local runtime is alive.

sourceMapping.description: Source-specific configuration opaque to the framework (e.g. {"repository":"owner/repo"} for GitHub). Forwarded verbatim to the connector's ingest call.

secretRef.description: Opaque pointer to a credential resolved at run time via a SecretResolver (e.g. "ss_abc123"). Never the token itself.
